stories.title: Deutsche Bank forecasts RBI may lift repo rate to 6.25% by mid‑2027
stories.summary: Deutsche Bank expects the Reserve Bank of India to raise its policy repo rate to 6.25% by mid‑2027 as inflation pressures persist. The bank projects consumer‑price inflation averaging about 6% in late 2026 and easing to 4.7% by FY 28, while GDP growth is forecast above 7% in FY 27 and FY 28.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Ceasefire extended across Kherson region
stories.summary: A ceasefire that began to bring food and medicine to the Russian‑occupied city of Oleshky has been expanded to cover the wider southern Kherson region, with no breaches reported since it started on Tuesday. Several thousand residents remain without electricity, food or water, and the broadened truce is intended to allow humanitarian convoys safe passage.

stories.title: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model with audio and real‑time editing
stories.summary: On Tuesday, Google DeepMind launched Genie 4 as a research‑preview world model that creates photorealistic, interactive environments and generates synchronized real‑time audio such as music, ambient sounds and dialogue. Users can type prompts during a simulation to change weather, camera angle, objects or characters, and the system can keep the scene consistent for up to two minutes, twice the duration of its predecessor. Gemini, Google’s AI model, is integrated as a director that plans steps while Genie 4 renders the visuals.
stories.why: The capability enables more immersive simulations and offers a way to test robotic or interactive scenarios in a virtual setting before real‑world deployment.
stories.previousTitle: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
